title: Medium Male Pain Grunts
author: unfa
description: A series of medium male grunts I've recorded for a project. These are a bit longer than my previous upload, more suitable for death sounds, than just pain grunts. Recorded with Behringer B-1 microphone, Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 3rd gen and Ardour at 48kHz/24-bit. Check out these shorter grunts as well: https://freesound.org/people/unfa/sounds/610991/
